digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, prerequisite-consistency criterion, focused finder/verifier/decide pipeline
propositions: A new focused prerequisite-consistency criterion must evaluate subject-plan compatibility against each direct prerequisite independently without injecting prerequisite data into general reviewers or changing parent/child behavior.

Focused finder and verifier calls must operate on stable canonical-ID-ordered prerequisite blocks with separate index domains from general findings; both domains must be independently reshaped and concatenated only after decisive verification.

Every readable pinned prerequisite must receive exactly one closed-schema disposition (consistent, finding, or indeterminate with specific reason codes); missing, duplicate, or invalid output must map to output-invalid or evaluation-error.

Indeterminate prerequisite coverage must force unsigned top-level INDETERMINATE verdict, but concurrent DET blockers must remain visibly retained in the blocking array; any deterministic structural failure must not be masked.

Finding identity for prerequisite-scoped findings must use a distinct length-prefixed four-field UTF-8 SHA-256 encoding; non-prerequisite findings retain the existing pipe-delimited encoding byte-for-byte.

A singleton oracle must establish absolute floors (recall≥0.90, false-acceptance≤0.10, coverage=1.00, attribution-error=0.00) before production packing is enabled; packed metrics must maintain non-regression against the pinned baseline.
